newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-RUSSIA KEEPER OVCHINNIKOV JOINS BENFICA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RUSSIA KEEPER OVCHINNIKOV JOINS BENFICA.

text.p: Sergei Ovchinnikov, Russia's imposing and extrovert goalkeeper, has joined Benfica. He will move from Lokomotiv Moscow to Lisbon in the summer.

"Ovchinnikov has signed a four-year contract with Benfica. It takes effect on July 31. Before this he will play for us," Lokomotiv assistant trainer Vyacheslav Koltsov said on Thursday. He declined to disclose the transfer fee.
Benfica's veteran Belgian keeper Michel Preud'homme, 37, recently extended his contract by two years.

Lokomotiv trainer Yuri Syomin said Benfica's interest in Ovchinnikov, 1.90 metres tall, was "prestigious" for the Moscow club, sixth in the Russian championship last season. The 1997 campaign opens on March 15.
Ovchinnikov has six international caps, four in the past year, as he has challenged Stanislav Cherchesov of Tirol Innsbruck for the No.1 jersey.
